summary: Frontend testing of photorealistic globe + SVG teardrop pins (iteration 7) with Playwright at 1920x1080 and 390x844. Textures: all 5 (/textures/earth-blue-marble.jpg, earth-topology.png, earth-water.png, clouds.png, night-sky.png) returned 200; 0 page errors in all runs (globeMaterial error is gone). Visual: blue-marble texture, bump, specular, blue atmosphere and clouds all render. PINS: over 12 states (3 presets + shuffle, on 2 viewports), every visible pin tip sits exactly at its wrapper anchor (0 tips off by more than 1px). Pill-pill overlaps were 0 and pill-pin overlaps were 0. 4-6 pins are visible per state; the rest are hidden on the far side of the globe, which is expected. PILLS ABOVE PINS: partial. In 11/12 states, 1-6 pills were pushed BELOW their own pin by the collision loop, which only pushes downward (e.g. desktop London shuffle: Sofia, Zagreb and Zurich all stacked beneath their pins; mobile London preset: 6/6). Leader lines are drawn, but the requirement that pills sit above pins is not met for clustered cities. CLICKS: real mouse clicks on destination pins opened the matching drawer card 4/4 (desktop + mobile), pill clicks matched 2/2, and the origin pin correctly opens nothing. Drawer close works (the element is removed). EXPLORE: the toggle sets aria-pressed=true. Points render as flush discs with no cylinders (checked zoomed in), and clicking a point opened the drawer for that city (Reykjavik, not in the batch). REGRESSION: shuffle OK. Share dialog + PNG download OK on both viewports (rent-mumbai-vs-kaunas-square.png). Edit keeps the city and rent and clears the destination pins; re-compare restores the pins. Mobile layout OK.

ui_bugs.issue: Pins are now obstacles and the loop only pushes down (top = hit.top + hit.h + 4), so in clustered regions (Europe) pills land below their pin, and sometimes below other pins. This happened in 11/12 states, with up to 6 pills per state on mobile. That breaks the requirement that pills sit above pins.
pointRadius 0.22 makes dots about 2-4px at overview altitude, which is very hard to hover or tap, especially on mobile. Hover/click only works reliably once zoomed in.

issues: Clustered pills stack in a column under the pins, which reads like a list detached from the pins. Consider trying upward and sideways candidate positions before pushing down.
Mobile: a pin near the top of the globe can sit partly under the glass panel (Mumbai re-compare at 80000).
Zoomed in, the arcs become very thick tubes crossing the view. Consider an arcStroke that scales with altitude.

action_items: In the GlobeView layout loop, try candidate offsets in this order: above (default), above-left/right, further above (top = hit.top - it.h - 4), and only then below, so that pills stay above their pins.
Optional: increase pointRadius (or scale it by camera altitude) so explore dots are tappable at overview zoom.
Optional: treat the .glass-panel rect as an exclusion zone for pins and pills on mobile.
critical_code_review_comments: GlobeView.onReady starts an rAF tick loop (clouds/sun) that is never cancelled. If the component remounts, loops accumulate.
The layout loop still runs querySelectorAll plus getBoundingClientRect every frame, forever, and now covers pins too.
The cloud mesh is added via g.scene().add and is not part of the raycast objects, so it does not block clicks (verified).
Module-level TextureLoader for the specular map runs at import time. That works, but there is no error handler.

success_rate.frontend: 90% (all functional checks pass; pills-above-pins requirement fails for clustered cities)

context_for_next_testing_agent: The browser tool rewrites screenshot paths inside f-strings, so use plain string paths. Pin anchor = pin.parentElement rect (left/top). Click pins/pills with mouse.click at the bbox centre. Explore point click: zoom in with the wheel, hide .globe-pin/.globe-pill via add_style_tag, find emerald pixels (g>170, r<90) in a PNG screenshot with PIL, hover for 250ms until .globe-tip shows, then mouse down/up. Grid scans are too slow (they exceed the 480s limit). A 'notAbove' metric (pill.bottom > pin.top) is in globe_pins_iter7.py.
